commit: feat(apiWatch): support passing the number type for deep to control the watch depth

truth.description: traverse now returns at once when it gets no depth, and withDirectives still calls it with none for a directive marked deep, so the deep flag of vModelCheckbox and vModelSelect no longer tracks the bound array, and a push to a checkbox group's array no longer re-renders the checkboxes.

distractions.why: reactiveGetter treats deep: 0 like deep: false and still traverses the root level, so the change to bar triggers the callback while the change under foo does not.
